title: Shimmer Trace
description: Skeleton loading that traces your real markup: wrap content in Shimmer and it measures the rendered elements and paints one synchronized shimmer over them. Five animations, list cloning, Suspense.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show the skeleton. False renders the children untouched.

props.name: children
props.description: The content to trace (rendered hidden while loading).

props.name: baseColor / highlightColor
props.description: Block and highlight colors (any CSS color, including var(--token)).

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: One radius for every block. Unset: each element's own radius (4px when it has none).

props.name: preserveBackground
props.description: Keep card backgrounds, borders and spacing visible and hide only text and media. False hides the whole tree.

props.name: dummyData
props.description: Props merged into each child while loading, so it renders a realistic shape without data.

props.name: dummyLength
props.description: Clone the first child this many times while loading (lists).

props.name: as
props.description: Render this component (dummyLength times, with dummyData) instead of the children while loading.

props.name: stopPropagation
props.description: Paint its own overlay even when nested in another Shimmer (nested ones report to the outer one by default).

props.name: className / style
props.description: On the container (it is always position: relative).

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Labs addition: what screen readers announce while loading.

a11y: While loading, the traced content is aria-hidden and a polite live region next to it (role="status", visually hidden, outside the hidden subtree) announces `loadingLabel`. Upstream's own status sat inside the aria-hidden container, so it was never announced (a Labs fix). The live region is absolutely positioned, so block, flex and grid parents lay out exactly as before.
While loading the container ignores pointer events and selection, as upstream; the controls inside are hidden from assistive technology until the content loads.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the blocks are static and base-colored: no sweep, pulse or glow (a Labs addition).
In right-to-left pages the blocks follow the mirrored layout and the sweep runs right to left.
docs:
Installed `Shimmer`, `createShimmer`, `ShimmerSuspense` and `useIsShimmering` (`@/components/ui/shimmer-trace`), with the tracer and types in `@/components/ui/shimmer-trace-core`. No dependencies.

```tsx
import { Shimmer } from "@/components/ui/shimmer-trace";

<Shimmer loading={isLoading} dummyData={{ user: placeholderUser }}>
  <ProfileCard user={user} />
</Shimmer>
```

Wrap the content you would render when loaded: while `loading` it is rendered hidden, measured, and covered by one synchronized shimmer. Give it `dummyData` (or `as` plus `dummyLength` for lists) so it has a realistic shape before data arrives. Theme it with `baseColor` and `highlightColor`. The skeleton is measured in the browser, so server-rendered HTML shows the hidden content until it hydrates.
